items.stem: What must be the same when comparing two fractions of two wholes?
If 5 pieces of a paratha are eaten, how many parathas does that equal?
If Raman ate 7 pieces of a paratha and each paratha is cut into 4 equal parts, how many parathas did he eat?
If Raman’s family of 6 members ordered 2 pizzas and cut each pizza into 3 equal slices, and Dadiji and Dadaji gave their slices to Raman, how much pizza does Raman have?
If Radhika ate 6 pieces of a paratha and each paratha is cut into 4 equal parts, how many parathas did she eat?
Raman gave 1/4 of a pizza to Radhika. If Radhika already had 1/2 of the pizza, what fraction of the pizza does she have now?
Radhika had 3/4 of a pizza. She then ate 1/2 of what she had. What fraction of the whole pizza did she eat?
Raman had 2/3 of a pizza. He gave 1/6 of the whole pizza to Radhika. What fraction of the pizza does Raman have left?
If 1/2 of a pizza is divided equally among 3 people, what fraction of the whole pizza does each person get?
Which of the following is an example of a fraction greater than one?
Which of the following fractions is equal to half?
If the numerator of a fraction is 3 more than its denominator and the fraction is 5/4, what is the original fraction?
If a fraction is reduced to its lowest terms, it becomes 3/4. What could the original fraction be?
A whole can be made using two different fraction pieces. One piece is 1/2 and two pieces of another fraction make a whole. What is the other fraction?
Raman's father cut a paratha into 4 equal parts. Dadiji took 9 pieces of the paratha. How many whole parathas did she eat?
Raman's family had 2 pizzas, each cut into 3 slices. Dadiji and Dadaji gave their slices to Raman, Maa and Baba gave theirs to Radhika. How much pizza does Radhika have?
A fraction is equivalent to 1/2. If the denominator of the fraction is 10, what is the numerator?
Which of the following is an example of a fraction greater than one?
What are fractions called when they represent the same part of a whole but have different names?
Which of the following is a fraction that is equal to one?
Raman ate 6 pieces of paratha. If each paratha is cut into 2 equal parts, how many whole parathas did he eat?
Raman gave 1/4 of a pizza to Radhika. If Radhika had already 1/2 of the pizza, how much of the pizza does she have in total?
A number line is divided into 8 equal parts. If a point is located at 5/8, how far is it from 1?
